events.description: Tight hole at 1,642 m MD in Girujan clays; overpull 35 klbs on connection, reamed stand twice.
events.mitigation: Reamed on connections and raised KCl concentration.
events.lesson_learned: Girujan clays respond well to increased inhibition; ream early.

events.description: Partial losses of 12 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sands at 2,418 m MD with 9.8 ppg mud; 65 bbl lost before cure.
events.mitigation: Pumped 35 ppb LCM pill and reduced flow rate; losses cured after 4 hrs.
events.lesson_learned: Tipam losses in this well match DLJ-21 experience at similar depth.

events.description: Restricted movement after connection at 1,529 m MD (Girujan); reamed stand three times.
events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
events.lesson_learned: Hole cleaning limits ROP in Girujan; drill at a controlled rate.

events.description: Drag increased to 94 klbs at 1,659 m MD across Girujan clays; back-reamed to shoe.
events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Girujan; do not wait for drag to increase.

events.description: Tight hole at 2,321 m MD in Tipam; overpull 63 klbs on trip out, reaming required through 48 m interval.
events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Tipam; do not wait for drag to increase.

events.description: Torque increased from 9 to 13 kft-lb at 2,912 m MD on entering Barail coal seams; stick-slip observed and ROP dropped from 9 to 4 m/hr.
events.mitigation: Reduced WOB/RPM, circulated bottoms-up and added lubricant to the mud system.
events.lesson_learned: Upper Barail coal seams produce torque spikes 20-40 m below the top; pre-condition the mud before entering.

events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 2,940 m MD in Barail shale/coal sequence. Overpull to 85 klbs, no rotation. Worked pipe with jarring for 4.5 hrs; freed after spotting 30 bbl lubricant pill. Torque had risen from 9 to 14 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.
events.mitigation: Increased circulation before connections; short reaming intervals; improved hole conditioning with hi-vis sweeps.
events.lesson_learned: Rising torque trend in upper Barail is a precursor to stuck pipe; ream every stand and keep jars armed below 2,900 m.

events.description: Shale instability at 1,412 m MD in Girujan; 39 bbl of cavings circulated out over 24 hrs.
events.mitigation: Increased mud inhibition and reduced surge/swab by slower trips; cavings reduced within 12 hrs.
events.lesson_learned: Minimise open-hole time in Girujan; shale destabilises within days.

events.description: Shale instability at 1,806 m MD in Girujan; 118 bbl of cavings circulated out over 24 hrs.
events.mitigation: Circulated at higher rate to clear cavings and drilled ahead with improved rheology.
events.lesson_learned: Minimise open-hole time in Girujan; shale destabilises within days.

events.description: Sudden loss of returns at 2,412 m MD in Tipam; loss rate 11 bbl/hr. Standpipe pressure dropped 113 psi.
events.mitigation: Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.

events.description: Partial losses of 15 bbl/hr observed while drilling Tipam at 2,485 m MD with 9.8 ppg mud. Pit volume decreased 42 bbl before losses were controlled.
events.mitigation: Pumped 31 ppb LCM pill (fine/medium) and reduced flow rate to lower ECD; losses cured after 6.9 hrs.
events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.

events.description: Torque spike to 15 kft-lb at 2,951 m MD (Barail); string stalled once before parameters were reduced.
events.mitigation: Reduced WOB/RPM and circulated bottoms-up.
events.lesson_learned: Expect torque increase in Barail coal seams; pre-empt with lubricant and a stabilised BHA.

events.description: Tight hole at 2,975 m MD in Barail; overpull 70 klbs on trip out, reaming required through 45 m interval. Restricted movement after each connection.
events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Barail; do not wait for drag to increase.

Cemented to surface with lead/tail slurry; top job not required.
Single-stage job with 600 m cement column; lift pressure achieved.
Liner-style tail slurry; top of cement confirmed by temperature survey. Cementing issue recorded at 3,604 m (Low); see events.

events.description: Partial losses of 10 bbl/hr observed while drilling Dhekiajuli at 1,221 m MD with 9.3 ppg mud. Pit volume decreased 16 bbl before losses were controlled.
events.mitigation: Pumped 33 ppb LCM pill (fine/medium) and reduced flow rate to lower ECD; losses cured after 2.8 hrs.
events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Dhekiajuli loss zone.

events.description: Tight hole at 1,756 m MD in Girujan; overpull 73 klbs on trip out, reaming required through 54 m interval.
events.mitigation: Performed wiper trip to shoe and drilled ahead with increased YP mud.
events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Girujan; do not wait for drag to increase.

events.description: Seepage to partial losses (49 bbl/hr) encountered in Tipam sands at 2,358 m MD; total loss 181 bbl.
events.mitigation: Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.

events.description: Sudden loss of returns at 2,480 m MD in Tipam; loss rate 46 bbl/hr. Standpipe pressure dropped 265 psi.
events.mitigation: Reduced mud weight by 0.2 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone.
events.lesson_learned: Pre-treat mud with LCM before entering Tipam sands; keep pills staged on surface.

events.description: Sudden loss of returns at 2,924 m MD in Tipam; loss rate 16 bbl/hr. Standpipe pressure dropped 165 psi.
events.mitigation: Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
events.lesson_learned: Loss zones in Tipam correlate across the field; anticipate them at similar depth.

events.description: Erratic torque (10-16 kft-lb) with pack-off tendency at 2,988 m MD in Barail coal/shale.
events.mitigation: Lowered RPM, added lubricant to mud system and reamed the interval before drilling ahead.
events.lesson_learned: Monitor the torque trend, not the absolute value, when drilling Barail.

events.description: String stuck at 3,012 m MD in Barail after 35 min static during survey. Overpull 110 klbs, no rotation. Freed after 9 hrs of jarring and a 40 bbl pipe-freeing pill.
events.mitigation: Applied controlled overpull to 110 klbs, spotted pipe-freeing agent and regained rotation after 9 hrs; reamed interval twice.
events.lesson_learned: Avoid static pipe across Barail coal seams; keep pipe moving during surveys and connections.

events.description: String stuck at 3,257 m MD (Barail) after 25 min static during survey. Overpull 67 klbs.
events.mitigation: Worked pipe with jars for 11.3 hrs, spotted 49 bbl lubricant pill and freed string; reamed interval twice.
events.lesson_learned: Improve lubricity before entering Barail; differential sticking risk is high.

events.description: String stuck at 3,268 m MD (Barail) after 32 min static during survey. Overpull 93 klbs.
events.mitigation: Applied controlled overpull to 93 klbs, spotted pipe-freeing agent and regained rotation after 13.9 hrs.
events.lesson_learned: Improve lubricity before entering Barail; differential sticking risk is high.

events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 3,302 m MD in Barail. Overpull to 85 klbs, no rotation. Torque had risen from 11.3 to 21.3 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.
events.mitigation: Worked pipe with jars for 8.3 hrs, spotted 20 bbl lubricant pill and freed string; reamed interval twice.
events.lesson_learned: Improve lubricity before entering Barail; differential sticking risk is high.

events.description: Tight hole at 3,345 m MD in Barail; overpull 64 klbs on trip out, reaming required through 68 m interval.
events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Barail; do not wait for drag to increase.

events.description: Drilling break followed by 211 bbl pit gain at 3,492 m MD in Kopili. Influx circulated out; MW raised to 13.5 ppg.
events.mitigation: Flow-checked, closed BOP, circulated influx out and increased MW to 13.5 ppg with kill-line monitoring.
events.lesson_learned: Flow-check every connection in Kopili; connection gas trends precede kicks.

events.description: Lift pressure not achieved during 7" casing cement job; losses of 32 bbl during displacement at 3,604 m MD (Kopili).
events.mitigation: Top job carried out through annulus; casing pressure-tested to 2500 psi.
events.lesson_learned: Two-stage cementing recommended where Kopili losses occur.
